list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18; names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, guides and sources added by Leonida Ledger

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum awards itself once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no multiplayer and no DLC in the list, so everything else in this guide is effectively the checklist for this one. Work the roadmap in order and this is the last trophy that pops.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies — this one awards itself last
Work the five roadmap phases in order; there is no multiplayer or DLC in the list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: it unlocks on its own when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening main mission of Chapter 1. Nothing to prepare — just start the game.
steps: Play Chapter 1's opening main mission, Gone Fishing
Finish the mission — the trophy pops on its own

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing Chapter 1. It actually pops as you finish the first main mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?), so do not worry if the credits for the chapter roll first.
steps: Complete Chapter 1
Keep playing: it pops as you finish Chapter 2's first main mission, What's in the Bag?

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for completing Chapter 2. It pops as you finish the first main mission of Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City).
steps: Complete Chapter 2

steps: Complete Chapter 3

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long gold. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — roughly 60% of true completion: most collectible types and side quests are not required at all, you need any 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only tasks that demand everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. Nothing toward it is missable.

sources.name: GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
Scan any 200 of 277 vehicles with the WAiNK app as you play
Study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges
Finish in full: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests
trophies.tip: Roughly 60% of true completion is enough: most collectible types and side quests are not required at all, and progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, mixed however you like. The bridge flights are the quickest to bank. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map's Exploration layer. Note the 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so this trophy lands on the way.
steps: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixed however you like
Bank the 202 under-the-bridge flights first — they are the quickest
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts
trophies.tip: The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so this trophy lands on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 tracked activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. The story introduces most of them and the rest appear as you unfog the map; check what is missing under Progress > Activities. In practice this pops on its own while you work on everything else.
steps: Try each of the 9 tracked activity types once
Fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool and basketball
Play a video game, win a race or drone race, and perform a stunt
Check what is missing under Progress > Activities

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. Gold medals here also feed the 100% checklist, which requires the ranges in full, so there is no shortcut version of this one — settle in and learn each weapon class's target pattern.
steps: Find the 12 Shooting Range locations
Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges
Learn each weapon class's target pattern — the 100% checklist needs the ranges in full too

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, but the trophy only needs one win per location, so take the shortest course each site offers.
steps: Visit all 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win one race at each location — take the shortest course each site offers

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — they must be distinct events, not the same one repeated. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the shortest street races and skip anything that keeps beating you.
steps: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same event do not count
Pick the shortest street races among the 40 unique locations

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1's Feng Shui mission introduces Cal, he will text you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge to earn this.
steps: Finish Chapter 1's Feng Shui mission to meet Cal
Follow Cal's text to the fishing spot with the purple map icon
Work through his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game in full — finishing all of its levels once is enough, its challenges are not required. Three of the four games (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind) are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, sits on arcade machines around the world.
steps: Pick one arcade game and finish all of its levels once
Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are on the TV at home from Chapter 1
Bang For Your Buck is the fourth game, on arcade machines around the world

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and marks itself automatically in Chapter 3: she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. The line runs five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
steps: Play as Lucia: Andy's line marks itself in Chapter 3 — she calls, then texts her Belville address
Run the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It marks itself in Chapter 1 (the green KR icon in Key Lento) after Island Dreams: he sends you to purple-marked shipwrecks, where you dive and use the metal detector to dig up treasure and bring it back — 7 wrecks in total. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns during Chapters 2–3, and everything stays available after the story, so this is not missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
steps: Meet Kenton in Key Lento (green KR icon) after Island Dreams in Chapter 1
Dive the purple-marked shipwrecks and use the metal detector to dig up treasure
Bring the treasure back — 7 wrecks in total; track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, which marks itself after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them remain available after the story.
steps: Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Chapter 2's Coffee Break
Run Billy's five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain open-world questlines count as strangers — confirmed strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — while many character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy and others) do not count toward this trophy even though they are worth doing. Strangers remain findable in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker shows how many strands you have banked.
steps: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers
Confirmed strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete
Character lines (Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy…) do not count toward this trophy

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. After Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS delivers him the first car, Randy (green RK icon, west Vice City) asks for 16 named sports cars in total. He marks some in fixed spots; the rest you find yourself — scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage, ideally undamaged for a better payout. The list can be finished after the story.
steps: After Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS delivers Randy his first car
Find all 16 named sports cars on Randy's Wish List
Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to spot listed ones, then drive them back to his garage

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is Jason-only and marks itself after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. First destroy the Synthetic Labs around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest); after enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, which earns the trophy. Still available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason: Tyrone's line marks itself after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty
Destroy the Synthetic Labs around Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter)
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, and finish it

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double, and you can track the count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. WARNING — the one missable trophy in the game: the first meditation happens at Jason's house during Chapter 1, when Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony after the Down to Earth mission. Follow her, accept, and meditate with her. That spot becomes permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends, and whether it is strictly required is still being confirmed — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped, so treat it as required. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as insurance, because there is no mission replay.

sources.name: GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, follow Lucia at Jason's house when she goes to meditate on the balcony — accept and meditate with her
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as insurance (no mission replay)
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; spots done with both Jason and Lucia count double
Track the count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations
trophies.tip: Whether the Chapter 1 spot is strictly required is still being confirmed — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped, so treat it as required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret texts you his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots where you hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him — the requests are tracked as Target Decks (Map > Activities), and all 15 decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy arrives along the way. It is still being confirmed which specific animal completes the line. Bret lends you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; one clean shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more, but that is optional.
steps: Play as Jason: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret texts his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County
Hunt the animals Bret requests at his marked spots and bring them back
Work his Target Decks (Map > Activities) — all 15 decks also feed the 100% checklist
trophies.tip: Bret lends you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle; one clean shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more, but that is optional. Which specific animal completes the line is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in total, so pick the three whose cards cluster closest together and leave the rest — no trophy or checklist entry needs them all.
steps: Complete any 3 collectible card sets
Pick the three sets whose cards cluster closest together — nothing needs all 18 sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It — scan — at 100 locations. WAiNK targets are landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags scattered over the state; scan one by holding Up and then R1 while looking at it. There are more than 100 in the world, so any hundred you pass on your travels will do.
steps: WAiNK-scan 100 locations: landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags
Hold Up, then R1, while looking at a target to scan it
There are more than 100 in the world — any hundred you pass will do

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in the game and the 100% checklist needs any 70 of them, so this trophy unlocks on the way if you keep challenges in your rotation. Track them under Progress > Challenges and save it for late in the run — by then most will already be done without trying, and you can cherry-pick the quickest of what is left.
steps: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges
Track them under Progress > Challenges
Save it for late in the run and cherry-pick the quickest of what is left

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. This needs both characters free-roaming together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break: call your partner in, cause enough carnage to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone — the trophy pops when you exit the heat, not the search area. A fast motorcycle helps, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape because helicopters cannot track you inside. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission line, which forces 4-star escapes.
steps: Unlock free-roaming together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, then call your partner in
Reach a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone — it pops when you exit the heat
trophies.tip: The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape — helicopters cannot track you inside. The Chapter 4 bank-vault line also forces 4-star escapes with your partner, which earns this on its own.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while your wanted level stays up the whole time — if you lose the flashing wanted level, the chain breaks. Bring armour and healing, call your partner in, and work a tight cluster: the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) are ideal. Loot a couple of items per store and crack the back-room safe if you can; the trophy pop can lag about 30 seconds after the third shop, and hitting a fourth shop is the fallback if it does not register.
steps: Call your partner in and bring armour and healing
Rob 3 shops back-to-back while the wanted level stays up — losing it breaks the chain
The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are the ideal cluster
trophies.tip: The trophy pop can lag about 30 seconds after the third shop — hitting a fourth shop is the fallback if it does not register. Loot a couple of items per store and crack the back-room safe if you can.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up to raise the app, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough — you never have to drive them. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan traffic as it passes. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so starting early makes this one automatic. Check totals under Progress > Vehicles.
steps: Raise the WAiNK app with Up, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it
Scan 100 vehicles — scanning is enough, you never have to drive them
Stand on a busy road and scan traffic as it passes; check totals under Progress > Vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation (L3 + R3 while aiming): time slows and weak spots light up, but the purple focus bar only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first — eat, drink or shower to buff focus, use Adrenaline to stretch the timer, wear body armour, and line the five up at a gang operation with an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. It does not appear to count on police, soldiers or civilians. Raising Focus to level 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) makes the window much more forgiving, and most players earn it naturally by then.
steps: Buff up first: eat, drink or shower for focus, use Adrenaline, wear body armour
Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation with an accurate full-auto rifle
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down all 5 in one activation
trophies.tip: Raising Focus to level 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) makes the few-second window much more forgiving — most players earn this naturally by then. It does not appear to count on police, soldiers or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA: steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal's boarding bridge — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. The easiest sits at terminals E3/E4; slip through the fence, use the stairs by the bridge to board, taxi back to the runway, take off and fly roughly 1 km away from the airport for the (slightly delayed) pop.
steps: Go to a departure terminal's boarding bridge at VCIA — the easiest planes sit at terminals E3/E4
Board a large passenger plane docked at the bridge (open-airfield planes do not count)
Take off and fly roughly 1 km away from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and make some noise. The tanks sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.
steps: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map
Slip in through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance
Climb into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This needs the Snap Gun, the silent lockpick gadget unlocked by Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which also unlocks the jewelry store robberies themselves (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and empty the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
steps: Unlock the Snap Gun via Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick it in
Find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe undetected
trophies.tip: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vault jobs unlock with Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which walks you through the first: tail the security van, slip in while the vault is open, and split the cash with your partner. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 that mark more vans to follow. Every vault job brings an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and swap vehicles afterwards. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist wants all of them (up to $205,000 each), so this silver lands on the way.
steps: Unlock vault jobs with Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is…
Buy Yasmani's $10,000 security-van tips to mark more vans to follow
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each 4-star wanted level — a fast motorcycle helps

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat zone. The bank-vault jobs unlocked by Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… count automatically — tailing the truck to the bank and emptying its vault is the same robbery. To do it earlier, block a roaming armored truck near a bank, blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb (Yasmani's shop stocks them after his Chapter 3 quests), grab the cash and get out of the heat.
steps: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat zone
Chapter 4's bank-vault jobs count automatically
Earlier: block a roaming truck near a bank, blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb, grab the cash

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. Driving every road takes forever; the practical method is to take a plane and sweep the regions still blacked out until the whole map is revealed.
steps: Fully unfog the map of Leonida
Take a plane and sweep the regions still blacked out — far faster than driving every road

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons as you come near them (many are also marked by story progress), but the trophy only needs one per gang. Track your per-gang count under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39, so this arrives on the way.
steps: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs
One operation per gang is enough, of 39 in total (yellow icons)
Track your per-gang count under Progress > Gangs

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations, visited during Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The three: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east office, which you open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on the third pickup, and the valuables can be collected across separate visits if the robbery icon respawns — so despite the story timing, this one is not missable.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation; also Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling)
Steal the luxury watch in the south-east office
Steal the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner
Blow the safe in the north-east office with sticky bombs and take its contents
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, and valuables can be collected across visits

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check the stat under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength. From Chapter 2's Coffee Break onward you can call your partner along, and while one character works out at a fitness club the other trains automatically — double progress for single effort. Filter the map's Activities layer for fitness clubs; working out at home after the story also counts.
steps: Raise Strength with both Jason and Lucia to maximum at the same time
Check the stat under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength
From Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner along: while one trains at a fitness club, the other trains automatically

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. Turn on the profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and a small icon appears whenever an action registers — clean robberies and evidence destruction push you toward Professional, incapacitating enemies toward Hardened, killing toward Violent and Psycho. Almost everything you do for the other trophies counts, so this fills passively; if it is somehow short at the end, repeated robberies farm it fast. One caution: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive, so avoid sustained excessive violence.
steps: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so each registered action shows
Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile — robberies, evidence destruction, combat
It fills passively during the other trophies; farm repeated robberies if it is short at the end
trophies.tip: Caution: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive, so avoid sustained excessive violence while farming actions.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your fence contacts. The system unlocks after Chapter 3's Credit Check, which gives you the Dye Pack Jammer; from then on, rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total accumulates across robberies, and the bank-vault jobs (up to $205,000 each) make short work of it once they unlock in Chapter 4.
steps: Unlock the system after Chapter 3's Credit Check, which gives you the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills
Deliver the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most — until $250,000 is laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total — every store type counts toward the same pot. Guns, vehicle mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it; the world has dozens of outlets (24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops and more), so this is a money sink, not a scavenger hunt.
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total — every store type counts toward the same pot
Guns, vehicle mods and tattoos burn through it fastest

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. They appear in the Vice City Real Estate app that installs on your phone after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, and cost $160,000 in total — robberies, especially the higher-value ones from Chapters 3–4, fund them quickly. The 4 story garages are separate and do not count toward this trophy, but the bought garages do double duty: their parking spots are what let you register vehicles for On the Spot.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app (installs after Chapter 2's Daily Driver)
Buy all 8 garage properties — $160,000 in total
The 4 story garages do not count; fund the bought ones with Chapter 3–4 robberies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which installs after Chapter 2's Moses mission and lets you summon registered cars anywhere. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register, at his garage. Each registration needs a free parking spot, so buy garages (Little Boxes) first, and register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the fees down. Early on Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
